definition.def: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.
examples: He has deceived and disillusioned us all. [VERB noun]
She deceived her father into thinking she was going to school. [VERB noun + into]

definition.def: If you deceive yourself, you do not admit to yourself something that you know is true.
examples: Alcoholics are notorious for their ability to deceive themselves about the extent of their problem. [VERB pronoun-reflexive]

definition.def: If something deceives you, it gives you a wrong impression and makes you believe something that is not true.
examples: His gentle, kindly appearance did not deceive me. [VERB noun]
The boys, if my eyes did not deceive me, were praying. [VERB noun]
